identification_chain: observe is exactly three actual modeRecordStep means: birth counts after requested write-false/write-true and paid expenditure after write-false. It does not return the parameter fields or policy-ordering answers.

probe_means_from_actual_parent proves the same means from every physical state and history provided the actual retained program equals the source goal. The writes overwrite the tested register; no additional reset, known initial physical state or history preparation permission is needed.

The two birth means sum to repairChance=1-epsilon. Positive repairChance follows from declared epsilon<1; it identifies the goal from which birth mean is nonzero and identifies writeCost from the paid mean divided by that same positive rate. observe_injective derives equality of the full Parameter, including unknown epsilon.

objective is the full actual fault-mode record-law Bochner integral for the exact supplied Deployment policy/initial memory, same label law, same epsilon, same price and founder history. objective_eq_actual_policy_value actually consumes the reviewed FaultJointRecord integral theorem.

actual_record_mechanism_faithful derives original MechanismTeleologicalFaithfulness by proved observation injectivity. observed_source_identifies_actual_purpose calls the original mechanismObservation_identifies_teleologicalClass; no hfaith or desired ordering is an input.

policy_oracle_audit.result: No true-epsilon oracle is required by the source execution, observation-faithfulness proof or literal witness policies.
policy_oracle_audit.evidence: Deployment remains the original sigma of CausalPolicy.{0,0,0} and initial memory. The same supplied run is evaluated under each parameter through external mode-law weights; policy action/advance receives its usual memory/action/actual next physical state and no fresh epsilon/mode/label argument. The positive witness uses literal constant none and some true actions, independently of epsilon.
policy_oracle_audit.limit: This is exact observational identifiability and equality of objective classes. No finite-data estimator, executable inverse, adaptive experimental learning algorithm or automatically learned selector is constructed. A common type of all comparison policies alone is not a formal epistemic restriction on how an external designer originally chose a policy.

independent_inputs_remaining: The registered finite Bool register substrate, reliable fixed-address writes, protected retained/copyable source program, and the actual program=goal invariant. The arbitrary-parent probe theorem assumes this real inherited-program relation; it does not infer arbitrary unknown program validity.

A single stable mechanism and environmental hazard shared by both write probes and deployment, with 0<=epsilon<1. Independent fresh mode/label factors and the literal fault semantics remain source-model contracts; they are not inferred from these probe formulas.

Permission to request both allowed write probes and read actual living-birth counts and paid controlled-write expenditures. Access to the three exact law means is an ideal experimental observation contract, not a finite-sample confidence guarantee.

NNReal write tariff, zero idle tariff, no controlled charge/birth in fault mode, and no additional environment/rebind/copy charge. Resource supply>=writeCost and nonnegative initial reserve remain independently specified sufficient conditions in the resource consumer.

Price, horizon, discount and founder history are common independent evaluation choices, not identified hidden source parameters. Faithfulness is a finite-objective statement for any fixed real discount; its policy-value adapter uses 0<discount<1. The separate infinite optimum requires price*writeCost<=1.
Arbitrary fixed label PMF is carried through both experiment and full record law; these three means do not identify its distribution. Policies do not observe the fresh labels.

Successful-child-to-maintenance remains a conditional one-generation literal-child implication. No infinite population, distinct global concurrent IDs, every-time target survival or infinite record path law follows.

nonvacuity_and_boundary.positive_example: Actual epsilon=1/4, goal=true, writeCost1 gives observe=(0,3/4,3/4). At fixed price1/2, discount1/2 and T1 from the same outside state, literal idle has actual record value0 and literal write-true has value3/8; arbitrary label PMF.
nonvacuity_and_boundary.zero_cost_and_zero_hazard: Generic family permits writeCost=0 and epsilon=0. It does not claim positive costs/hazard or nonconstant purpose for every parameter/horizon.
nonvacuity_and_boundary.total_fault: epsilon=1 is excluded from Parameter and total_fault_experiments_zero proves zero birth/paid-cost means for every parent/action. This is a parameter-observation degeneracy; there is no claim that the all-zero objective purpose class is unidentifiable.

mutation_scope: Only exclusive independent review JSON and external focused checker/logs; no source, shared exports, Git or GI changes.
